Fetch NDVI chips from CDSE over an AOI

fetch_ndvi.Rd

Tiles an area of interest (AOI) into WGS84 chips at a target resolution, then downloads NDVI GeoTIFFs from the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE) using a provided evalscript. The function is rate-limited, honors local caching, and records output metadata on the input object.

Usage

fetch_ndvi(
  df,
  out_dir,
  from,
  to,
  resolution_m = 10,
  tile_max_px = 2500,
  tile_overlap_px = 0,
  client,
  evalscript = .ndvi_evalscript_path(),
  rate = ratelimitr::rate(n = 2, period = 1),
  overwrite = FALSE,
  progress = TRUE,
  aoi = NULL,
  res_m = NULL,
  max_px = NULL,
  overlap_px = NULL,
  rate_n = NULL,
  rate_period = NULL
)

Arguments

df

A data object carrying the AOI. If aoi is not supplied, the function reads attr(df, "traktr_aoi"). The AOI must be an sf polygon/multipolygon with a valid CRS.

out_dir

Directory where output GeoTIFF files are written. Will be created if it does not exist.

from, to

Date range (inclusive) used to query NDVI imagery. Coerced with as.Date().

resolution_m

Target pixel size in meters used when requesting chips.

tile_max_px

Maximum tile width/height in pixels used by the tiler. Controls chip size and request count.

tile_overlap_px

Optional overlap between adjacent tiles in pixels.

client

OAuth client for CDSE. Typically an httr2 OAuth client or equivalent object.

evalscript

Path or character string containing the Sentinel Hub evalscript to compute NDVI.

rate

A ratelimitr::rate() object controlling request rate, e.g. ratelimitr::rate(n = 2, period = 1).

overwrite

Logical. If FALSE (default), existing files are skipped. If TRUE, files are re-downloaded.

progress

Logical. If TRUE (default), show progress messages and a progress bar.

aoi

Optional sf polygon/multipolygon. If supplied, overrides attr(df, "traktr_aoi").

res_m

Deprecated. Use resolution_m.

max_px

Deprecated. Use tile_max_px.

overlap_px

Deprecated. Use tile_overlap_px.

rate_n, rate_period

Deprecated. Use rate = ratelimitr::rate(n, period).

Value

The input df, returned invisibly, augmented with attributes describing outputs and call parameters (see Details).

Details

  • AOI handling: The AOI is validated, transformed to EPSG:4326, and used to build request chips. If the AOI has no CRS, the call aborts.

  • Caching: Filenames encode the chip bounding box (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) and the date range, which provides a stable cache key across runs.

  • Rate limiting: All remote requests are wrapped with ratelimitr.

  • Attributes:

    • attr(df, "ndvi_aoi") stores an sf index of chips with status and file paths.

    • attr(df, "ndvi_fetch_params") stores call parameters.

    • attr(df, "traktr_layers")$ndvi stores the same information in a harmonized container for downstream discovery.

See also

fetch_landuse, ratelimitr::rate

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
df <- some_traktr_object_with_aoi()
df <- fetch_ndvi(
  df,
  out_dir       = "data/ndvi",
  from          = as.Date("2024-06-01"),
  to            = as.Date("2024-06-30"),
  client        = my_cdse_client,
  resolution_m  = 10,
  overwrite     = FALSE,
  progress      = TRUE
)
# Inspect chip index
attr(df, "traktr_layers")$ndvi$index
} # }
